default.specialists: Only when measurable value exceeds handoff cost
default.skill_loading: Load only the named relevant skill; skills are lazy context
default.agentic_first_policy: Use the relevant skill and authorized specialist/MCP when they materially help; use CLI tools for deterministic proof or when matched evidence shows they fit better.
default.pattern_policy: Direct is default. Other patterns require real dependency, independent work, or bounded quality risk. No compulsory swarm or full-catalog prompt.

workflows.entry: One or few files; behavior and acceptance criteria are clear.
workflows.trust: read/write project only; no production action
workflows.no_ai: edit directly and run deterministic checks
workflows.acceptance: Requested behavior verified; no unrelated edits.

workflows.entry: New React/TypeScript UI or multi-component feature.
workflows.specialist: golden-engineer when UI complexity or parallel independent slice justifies handoff
workflows.pattern: direct by default; sequential design→build→test when dependent; parallel only disjoint components
workflows.trust: project filesystem; browser restricted to approved intranet/local fixture
workflows.no_ai: local React toolchain and saved design system; no package download
workflows.acceptance: State/error/empty behavior, keyboard/accessibility, responsive layout and tests pass.

workflows.entry: Small internal utility or workflow UI suited to Python.
workflows.specialist: golden-engineer if multi-module or concurrency issue
workflows.pattern: direct; evaluator-optimizer for a bounded bug/test loop
workflows.trust: bind local fixture to loopback; intranet service calls require approved endpoint
workflows.no_ai: Python stdlib and installed NiceGUI package; no dynamic installs
workflows.acceptance: Correct state/error handling and locally reproducible test evidence.

workflows.entry: API, schema, migration, or internal service boundary changes.
workflows.specialist: golden-architect for cross-service contract; golden-verifier for independent review
workflows.pattern: sequential for schema→API→tests; parallel only independent contract review
mcp: approved company Git/schema MCP if already connected
workflows.trust: internal endpoints only; credentials never in logs; no schema mutation without authorization
workflows.no_ai: mock contract and local SQLite fixture
workflows.acceptance: Success/error/auth/data integrity contracts verified; rollback path documented.

workflows.entry: Semiconductor/manufacturing measurements, process trends, or sampling.
workflows.specialist: golden-investigator for data provenance or statistical review
mcp: approved read-only internal data MCP only when available
workflows.trust: public fixture or approved data; production write disabled
workflows.no_ai: Python/SQLite analysis and fixed acceptance examples
workflows.acceptance: Units, missingness, grouping, and expected numerical results explicitly validated.

workflows.entry: Cross-cutting architecture, permissions, or codebase risk review.
workflows.specialist: golden-architect and golden-verifier only for independently separable reviews
workflows.pattern: sequential inventory→risk review→deterministic checks; parallel independent review for broad audit
workflows.trust: read-only review unless explicit fix task; no secrets output
workflows.no_ai: static inspection and standard-library manifest checks
workflows.acceptance: Claims tied to evidence; unknowns labeled; no self-reported approval.

workflows.entry: Investigate a synthetic or approved incident/log set.
workflows.specialist: golden-investigator when logs/data are large or patterns non-obvious
workflows.pattern: sequential timeline→hypotheses→discriminating checks; no multi-agent swarm
workflows.acceptance: Facts separated from hypotheses; correlation is not stated as causation.

workflows.entry: Measure a stated bottleneck and evaluate a bounded optimization.
workflows.specialist: golden-investigator for profiling; golden-verifier for result recheck
workflows.trust: synthetic/local load by default; production load requires explicit operations approval
workflows.acceptance: No performance claim without repeated comparable measures and correctness retained.

workflows.entry: Validate visible behavior in a local or approved intranet app.
workflows.pattern: direct; evaluator-optimizer for bounded defect repair
deterministic_tools: Playwright already staged with OS browser
workflows.trust: deny public URLs by company egress policy; no persistent profile or production writes
workflows.no_ai: manual checklist and local HTTP/UI tests
workflows.acceptance: All target journeys pass; browser/network scope documented.

workflows.entry: Create or update a design note, SOP, runbook, or repository diagram.
deterministic_tools: diagram render if local tool staged
workflows.trust: do not invent procedures or expose company details in public repo
workflows.acceptance: Accurate, accessible, source-controlled, and consistent with existing repository design.

workflows.entry: Prepare a Golden release or independently qualify a project.
workflows.trust: release preparation allowed; company qualification and production publish require human lead
workflows.no_ai: stdlib checks remain runnable with model disabled
workflows.acceptance: No mandatory missing evidence; no fabricated exception; human sign-off separate.

workflows.entry: Improve Golden standards, workflows, packaging, proof, or control.
workflows.specialist: one specialist per separable research or implementation slice
workflows.pattern: bounded sequential design→change→test; parallel read-only research if useful
workflows.trust: no company secrets; no external runtime actions; no production deployment
workflows.no_ai: scripts and checks operate without model
workflows.acceptance: Working change, truthful test evidence, scope preserved, status not overclaimed.
